name: Vasudev Siddh
headline: AI Engineer · Voice Agents & LLM Systems
location: India (IST) · Remote, overlaps the UK/EU workday
summary: AI engineer building production voice agents, LLM backends and search systems. Cut an AI assistant's time to first results from 72-122 s to under 10 s; created JustHireMe, an open-source job-search app with 2,200+ GitHub stars.

bullets: Made the AI agent honest about missing data: it never reports "couldn't read" as "nothing there".
Built default-deny permissions for agent data access; closed cross-tenant paths and a path-traversal bug.
Made the voice agent speak sooner by streaming speech sentence by sentence while the model is still generating.
Built on-device active-speaker detection and fixed audio aliasing in the native macOS app (Swift).
Moved production AI workflows off a third-party platform, proving parity with an LLM-as-judge evaluation.
experience.tech: TypeScript, Python, Swift, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, WebRTC, LiveKit, Deepgram, Playwright

bullets: Rebuilt the AI assistant backend in Python and FastAPI; its score on a 54-case evaluation rose from 32 to 52.

Built visual search over 3.48M image vectors (~15-21 ms on one GPU); cut keyword search from 10.6 s to 53 ms.
Built the nightly data pipeline for 650k+ products; embeddings raised attribute coverage from 0% to 99.5%.
Ran AWS, CI/CD and iOS TestFlight releases; shipped the team's work behind 1,144 backend and 592 native tests.
